en: The front side shows a sepia-toned, vintage photograph of a rural landscape with a river, a bridge, and several houses, one of which is marked with an 'X'. The caption reads 'Motiv från Torpshammar', and handwritten text at the top says 'Detta är Valmfors' villa' with an 'X' above a specific house. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence in Swedish, an address in Stockholm, and no visible stamp, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
